items.stem:
Tanvi deposits ₹10,000 in a bank that pays 1% interest per month, compounded monthly, for 4 months.
(i) Write the amount as P(1 + r)ⁿ with the values filled in. (ii) Using the first two terms of the binomial expansion, estimate the amount. (iii) Using the first three terms, estimate the amount. (iv) Find the exact amount to the nearest rupee and say which estimate is closer.
items.markingKey: (i) Amount = P(1 + r)ⁿ (1). (ii) P(1 + nr) (1). (iii) P(1 + nr + nC2 r²) (1). (iv) Exact value; adding more terms brings the estimate closer (1).
